missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Nominative subject. 'Университет' is a masculine noun in the nominative as the subject. 'Наш' and 'старый' are agreeing masculine modifiers.

missions.phrase: Я окончил университет в прошлом году.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Accusative object. 'Университет' is the accusative direct object of 'окончил'; an inanimate masculine noun keeps its base form. 'В прошлом году' sets the time.
Strategic focus: Instrumental after с. 'Университетом' is the instrumental form required by 'рядом с', marking what the cafe is near.

missions.phrase: Я иду в университет каждое утро.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Accusative of direction. 'Университет' takes the accusative after 'в' to express motion toward a destination. 'Каждое утро' marks the routine.
Strategic focus: Dative after к. 'Университету' is the dative form after 'к', marking the goal that the students approach.
Strategic focus: Prepositional location. 'Университете' takes the prepositional form after 'в' to mean studying at the institution. 'Нашем' agrees in the prepositional case.
Strategic focus: Genitive of possession. 'Университета' is the genitive form showing whose building it is. 'Здание' is the nominative subject described by 'большое'.
Strategic focus: Genitive singular after numeral. 'Университета' is genitive singular required by 'три'. 'В городе' is the prepositional location.
Strategic focus: Genitive plural after много. 'Университетов' is the genitive plural required by 'много'. 'Хороших' agrees in the genitive plural.
Strategic focus: Genitive after из. 'Университета' takes the genitive after 'из' to express coming from a place. 'Поздно' adds the time of return.
